issues.description: Method signature for adding guest students is inconsistent: the problem statement/UML and solution require `addGuestStudents(int)` but the template declares `addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)`. Students implementing the template will not match the specified API and likely fail signature-based tests/compilation.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to declare the required method signature exactly: `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }` (remove the boolean parameter). If validation is desired, add a separate helper or an overload, but keep the one-parameter method required by the specification.
